Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' Breaks Billboard Hot 100 Record

Ella Langley's song 'Choosin' Texas' has set a new record on the Billboard Hot 100 chart, spending 23 weeks at the number one position. This surpasses the previous record held by Mariah Carey's holiday song 'All I Want for Christmas Is You'. The Billboard Hot 100 chart has a history of 68 years.
